description: Registry of surveyed time-series datasets for twin calibration/validation (#87). Every entry carries a verdict and the reason, so the survey is never repeated from scratch. ACCEPT = physically-usable units, open licence, fetchable unattended. REVIEW = valuable but blocked on licence, login, or size. REJECT = unusable for a physical model, with the reason recorded so nobody re-downloads it hopefully.
vetting_rules: scripts/data_registry.py vet — physical units (a normalised [0,1] channel or negative DO fails), dead-sensor sentinels (-127, -999, 65535), saturation pinning, channel coverage vs logging_schema v1

datasets.title: Sensor-based aquaponics fish pond (4-pond subset, in repo)
datasets.source: Udanor et al. (2022), Data in Brief 43:108400, DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2022.108400
datasets.verdict_reason: in use; 232,745 rows; but ammonia/turbidity saturate at sensor ceiling and DO fails plausibility (#86) — trust verdicts in data/empirical_envelope.json

datasets.title: Sensor Based Aquaponics Fish Pond Datasets (full 12 ponds)
datasets.source: Ogbuokiri, Udanor et al., Kaggle DOI 10.34740/kaggle/dsv/2681778; same Data in Brief paper as iotpond
datasets.verdict_reason: the repo's 4 ponds are a subset — the full 12 include fortnightly catfish length/weight alongside water quality, the only open fish-growth-with-chemistry pairing found; needs a (free) Kaggle API key, so not fetchable unattended

datasets.title: A simple dataset of an aquaponic fish pond IoT (red tilapia, Indonesia)
datasets.source: Data in Brief (2023), PMC10293995; Mendeley DOI 10.17632/yd36bx6f8f.2
datasets.verdict_reason: 118,286 rows over 3 months, physical units, no login — the held-out independent system #87 asked for, limited to the channels it carries (no N species)

datasets.title: Multimodal aquaponic dataset for Salicornia (Ca' Foscari Venice)

fetch.note: 5.6 GB — fetch deliberately, not by default

datasets.role: coupling (inlet vs outlet water quality + plant biomass in one loop)
datasets.verdict_reason: rare inlet/outlet chemistry paired with weekly plant biomass in a real aquaponic loop — the best open dataset found for the water->plant coupling; 5.6 GB and a halophyte crop, so adopt selectively

datasets.title: Monteria (Colombia) aquaponics IoT series
datasets.verdict_reason: already normalised to ~[0,1] with the inverse transform unpublished (DO of -1.51); mass balance needs mg/L, not z-scores (#87). The 7-channel file in the same deposit has 12 rows — monthly aggregates, not a series

datasets.title: Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge 1st edition (2018, cucumber)
datasets.role: greenhouse (energy-balance validation: indoor vs outdoor climate, 6 compartments, 4 months)
datasets.verdict_reason: CC0, 9 MB, direct URL, paired indoor/outdoor climate — the easiest first dataset for validating the greenhouse climate model

datasets.title: Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge 2nd edition (2019-20, cherry tomato)
datasets.verdict_reason: CC0, 8.4 MB, six months with requested-vs-realised setpoints — validates both the climate model and control assumptions

datasets.title: 3rd Autonomous Greenhouse Challenge: lettuce images + ground truth
datasets.role: crop (lettuce fresh/dry-weight ground truth for the crop growth model)
datasets.verdict_reason: the practical stand-in for the unpublished Van Henten 1994 dataset — per-plant fresh/dry weight; 886 MB because it ships images, so fetch once, keep the JSON ground truth

datasets.title: Malawian tilapia progeny growth (O. karongae, O. shiranus)

fetch.note: weights are in-article tables, not a CSV deposit

datasets.role: fish_growth (weight every 14 d for 70 d under known 38%-CP feeding)
datasets.verdict_reason: genuine weight-vs-time-under-known-feeding curves for shape-checking the tilapia growth submodel; small, and needs transcription from HTML tables

datasets.title: ThingSpeak aquaculture feeder channels 1032489/1032494
datasets.license: UNDECLARED — public API access is not a licence (#87)
datasets.role: fish_growth (the only public feed-ration record found; no chemistry on the same system)
datasets.verdict_reason: behaviourally correct feed record (ration climbs with biomass at constant count) but licence undeclared; asking the channel owner is the small concrete task recorded in #87

datasets.title: NASA POWER daily agro-climate API
datasets.role: climate (site forcing for the production twin: any lat/lon, 1981-present, daily)
datasets.verdict_reason: no key, verified live; T2M °C and ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN MJ/m²/day (community=AG) drive the greenhouse + crop light model

datasets.title: Open-Meteo forecast + ERA5 archive API
datasets.role: climate (hourly archive + 16-day forecast; cross-check against NASA POWER)
datasets.verdict_reason: no key, verified live; hourly resolution where POWER is daily
